notes: All dimensions in inches unless noted.
Nominal sizes per North American standard. Actual sizes for rough sawn cedar may vary ±1/8 in from listed actual — verify with supplier.
Rough sawn cedar: no S4S planing. Leave rough face as received.
Board feet (BF) calculated using nominal dimensions: BF = (nom_thickness x nom_width x length_ft) / 12.
Add 15% waste factor to all BF totals when ordering.
All cut angles for compound cuts require a compound miter saw with positive stops — verify against test cut.
Order lumber slightly long (add 4-6 in to rafter and post lengths) and trim to final dimension on site.

cutList.cutAngleTopEnd_deg: Square (90°) — notch milled after installation or on bench

notchAtTop.description: Full-width bearing notch to seat 6x8 ring beam. Cut with circular saw and chisel, or table saw dado stack.

cutList.notes: Post cut length includes 1.5 in for beam bearing notch. Confirm final cut length after setting post base height.

cutList.cutAngleLeftEnd_deg: 60° miter (matching hexagon interior joint angle at post CL)
cutList.cutAngleRightEnd_deg: 60° miter (matching hexagon interior joint angle at post CL)
cutList.miterSetup: Set miter saw at 30° (complement of hexagon face angle). Both ends same direction — check before cutting.
cutList.notes: Beam ends meet at post CL. 60° included angle at each corner. Allow 1/16 in gap at each joint for expansion. Verify fit dry before final hardware installation.

cutAngleTopEnd.sawSetup: Compound miter saw: miter = 26.57°, blade tilt (bevel) = 23.4°. Crown side UP.
cutAngleTopEnd.note: All 6 cuts identical — do NOT reverse bevel. Test on scrap 4x6 before production run.

cutAngleBottomEnd.note: Seat depth = 1.5 in. Plumb cut at tail is vertical. Optional decorative tail profile at builder discretion.

cutList.totalHorizontalRun_ft_in: 6'-0" (from beam CL to hub CL + 12 in overhang)
cutList.notes: Order at 7'-0" to allow for compound cut waste. Mark crown side before laying out cuts.

cutList.cutLength_ft_in: 1'-0" (rough block, finish-milled to hex prism shape)
cutList.cutAngle: Six flat faces milled at 60° intervals — see D04
cutList.fabricationNote: Option A: 8x8 turning blank, mill 6 faces. Option B: Laminate 3x 2x8 x 12 in with waterproof glue + 3 in GRK screws, plane 6 faces.
cutList.notes: Finial or galvanized rain cap added after rafter installation. See D04 for geometry.

cutList.cutAngleBothEnds_deg: 45° plumb cut both ends (no side bevel — pure 45° miter)
cutList.notes: Diagonal length = sqrt(12^2 + 12^2) = 16.97 in. Add cut waste for 45° ends → 21 in cut length. Order 2-ft lengths.

cutList.material: Rough Sawn Cedar T&G (or S4S T&G at builder discretion)
cutList.cutNotes: Planks run parallel to each ridge rafter from hub outward (wedge-shaped bays). Each bay plank requires tapering — widest at eave, narrowest at hub. Set table saw to rip taper for each bay. Alternatively, use short radial planks and allow butt joints at mid-rafter.
cutList.notes: T&G cedar, random lengths 6-10 ft. Pre-cut tapered planks for each of 6 pie-wedge bays.

cutList.spec: #1 Blue Label Western Red Cedar Shingles, 18 in
cutList.notes: 4 bundles = 1 square (100 sq ft). Order 10 bundles = 250 sq ft coverage at 5.5 in exposure (adequate for 6:12 pitch). Hip and ridge caps: use #1 hip-and-ridge shingles, 2 bundles.

boardFootSummary.notes: Structural framing (posts + beams + rafters + hub + corbels) = 476.5 bf nominal. Add 15% waste = ~549 bf to order. Decking ordered separately by board footage. Shingles ordered by bundle.
